mode.description: Active access mode. 'cloud' = WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API + Business Management API on Meta Graph). 'web' = WhatsApp Web multidevice (whatsmeow) personal-account mode. The two modes' credentials are never conflated.

base_url.description: Meta Graph API base URL (includes graph version). Override for tests or proxies.

waba_id.description: WhatsApp Business Account (WABA) ID for Business Management API reads (cloud mode).

phone_number_id.description: Phone Number ID used for messaging, media, profile, and registration (cloud mode).

page_size.description: Records per page for paginated Graph list reads (1-100).

max_pages.description: Maximum pages to fetch; 0 exhausts a paginated stream.

start_date.description: RFC3339 lower bound for time-windowed analytics reads.

store_dir.description: WhatsApp Web (whatsmeow) local store directory for the QR session and SQLite state (web mode). No session secret is read or printed at inspection.

access_token.description: Meta Graph API access token (system-user or app token) for Bearer auth in cloud mode. Used only for Authorization; never logged or printed.
